gelman2005_anova.title: Analysis of variance—why it is more important than ever

shared_changes.description: In the negative equicorrelation paragraph, replace the claim that a 3×3 matrix is positive definite for rho <= 1/2 with rho < 1/2; at equality its smallest eigenvalue is zero, so it is positive semidefinite but singular. Clarify the K-group lower bound similarly. The source text feeds this article and the chapter.

Clarify the estimation sentence saying covariance parameters themselves depend on beta: the covariance parametrization can be independent of beta, though joint estimation couples fixed-effect and variance estimates. The source sentence feeds this article and the chapter.
